title: Old Rules in the Field
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：shall　|　正文 303 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shall 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 nobody in the field ① should pay the fine within a week, and every player there remembered the fact for years. Three seasons on the world had turned over: by then even the youngest player ② shall pay the fine within a week in silence, and nobody troubled to watch. My uncle wrote the change into the record at once, and read the line aloud once every season thereafter.

The rules, though, were older than either of those worlds. A visitor ③ shall not pay the fine within a week before the April rains; the coach ④ should not pay the fine within a week either, and said so plainly to anybody who asked. Nobody in the field ever thought of arguing with him about it.

⑤ Should anybody pay the fine within a week, my uncle wanted to know, without the coach standing beside them? My mother, who heard every version of the story, said we ⑥ should pay the fine within a week once the record was signed and not a day before. Even the oldest player agreed with her in the end.

By 1971 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the record: the work ⑦ shall be counted before the April fair, and nothing was said otherwise. My uncle swore it ⑧ should have been counted long before anybody thought to ask. Should it truly have been counted so early? Nobody there could say.

⑨ In 1975 only one person in the whole field should pay the fine within a week without help, and my mother kept the name in the record for thirty years. ⑩ Even today a stranger shall not pay the fine within a week without permission, and that, my mother said in 1977, is what the old rule was really about. She repeated the sentence whenever the field forgot itself.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. modal. 将要（过去形式 should pay the fine within a week：1965 年那时候人人如此）
B. modal. 将要（现在形式 shall pay the fine within a week：如今连最小的队员也一言不发地做得到）
C. modal. 必须（规定）（现在形式的否定 shall not pay the fine within a week：规矩不许，如今也仍然如此）
D. modal. 将要（过去形式的否定 should not pay the fine within a week：那时的教练也不能这么做）
E. modal. 将要（疑问句 should anybody pay the fine within a week?：叔叔当年追问的话）
F. modal. 将要（间接引语 she said we should pay the fine within a week：转述母亲的话）
G. modal. 将要（被动 shall be counted：活儿被 counted 才算办妥）
H. modal. 将要（完成式 should have been counted：对早先情形的推断）

items.q: should pay the fine within a week
shall pay the fine within a week in silence
shall not pay the fine within a week before
should not pay the fine within a week
should anybody pay the fine within a week,
we should pay the fine within a week once
should pay the fine within a week without help
shall not pay the fine within a week without permission

answers.why: shall 表将要，1965 年球场里没有一个人一周内缴那笔罚金，叙述过去的事，故用过去形式 should。
shall 表将要，多年之后连最年轻的队员都一言不发地一周内缴那笔罚金，说现在的情况，用 shall。
shall 表必须（规定），规矩上说客人不得一周内缴那笔罚金，否定形式是 shall not pay the fine within a week。
shall 表将要，教练当年也不能这么做，过去形式的否定是 should not pay the fine within a week。
shall 表将要，叔叔追问的是“难道没有人能一周内缴那笔罚金吗”，疑问句 should anybody pay the fine within a week?
shall 表将要，母亲说的是“簿子签过之后我们才一周内缴那笔罚金”，间接引语里用 should。
shall 表将要，赛事记录上那行字是说活儿必须在集前被人 counted，被动形式 shall be counted。
shall 表将要，叔叔断定活儿老早就被 counted，对过去的推断用 should have been counted。
shall 表将要，1975 年只有一个人无人相助也能一周内缴那笔罚金，用过去形式 should。
shall 表必须（规定），母亲 1977 年说，如今生人没有许可仍不得一周内缴那笔罚金，否定 shall not pay the fine within a week。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，球场里没有一个人一周内缴那笔罚金，人人都把这件事记了好多年。（should pay the fine within a week）
多年以后，连最年轻的队员都一言不发地一周内缴那笔罚金。（shall pay the fine within a week）
按老规矩，客人在四月雨季之前不得一周内缴那笔罚金。（shall not pay the fine within a week）
那位教练当年也不能一周内缴那笔罚金，谁问他就直说。（should not pay the fine within a week）
母亲说，簿子签过之后我们才可以一周内缴那笔罚金，早一天也不行。（she said we should pay the fine within a week）
叔叔一口咬定，那件活儿早在有人过问之前就被 counted 了。（should have been counted）
answers: In 1965 nobody in the field should pay the fine within a week, and every player there remembered the fact for years.
Three seasons on, even the youngest player shall pay the fine within a week in silence.
A visitor shall not pay the fine within a week before the April rains.
The coach should not pay the fine within a week either, and said so plainly to anybody who asked.
My mother said we should pay the fine within a week once the record was signed and not a day before.
My uncle swore that it should have been counted long before anybody thought to ask.
